name: UW Health
verdict: UW Health is the combined clinical enterprise of the University of Wisconsin Hospitals and Clinics Authority, a public body corporate and politic created by Wisconsin statute.
note: Rating note: the owner is a Wisconsin public authority created by Wis. Stat. §233.02(1); per METHOD.md, a public owner in a US state is not a link to abuse, whatever its stake. On hold for a maintainer.
